clips.title: The story
paras: Along Ashenvale’s eastern border, a Warsong Outrider prepares a dispatch for the Horde. Stationed there, the outrider records frontline intelligence for couriers serving the Horde to carry, helping secure the crossing toward Azshara and strengthen the orcish foothold against night elf resistance.

Beyond Splintertree Post, the eastern road runs toward the ancient ruins of Azshara through Ashenvale’s volatile borderlands. Mounted orcish vanguards patrol this frontier and record tactical sightings, patrol movements, and resource evaluations. They send their field notes to Kadrak at the northern watchtower, which guards the Barrens border. The reports give Horde commanders a clear view of enemy troop concentrations and territorial threats beneath the forest canopy.
